title: Dashboard Polish & Operations
summary: A dashboard-wide refinement pass improves navigation, administration, health visibility, accessibility, wording, Wiki quality, Sentinel questions, mobile usability and overall visual balance.

sections.title: Command Deck & Navigation
items: Expanded Ctrl/Cmd+K from search into an action launcher for common dashboard workflows.
Added a global Quick Create menu and a universal right-side Inspector for ships, builds, Port Battles, captains, Wiki results and map locations.
Added actionable notification controls, category filtering, one-hour snooze and clearer next-step buttons.
Added last-known-state recovery and data-freshness messaging so short connection interruptions do not blank the dashboard.

sections.title: Administration & Health
items: Reorganized Administration into Basic, Advanced and Diagnostics views with clearer descriptions and contextual help.
Added a Review Changes step before saving important configuration updates.
Added a System Health view for the core service, database, live state, audio engine, dashboard and music workers.
Added privacy-conscious client performance telemetry for navigation, LCP, CLS and INP, summarized in Diagnostics.

sections.title: Wiki
items: Renamed Living Wiki to Wiki throughout the member experience.
Expanded conversational question handling for slang, shorthand, follow-ups, comparisons, crafting, trade, builds and casual phrasing.
Removed provenance, source-set and implementation terminology from normal member-facing answers while preserving it internally for review.
Reworked rough system articles and fallback data presentation into readable facts and tables.
Rewrote the Shipbuilding and Boarding guides into structured player-facing articles based only on the existing Wiki material.
Restricted the Wiki source inventory endpoint to administrators.

sections.title: Sentinel
items: Expanded natural-language flexibility for casual questions about members, roles, channels, access, removals and recent changes.
Improved conversational follow-ups and context handling.
Reworded the dashboard around operator-friendly server history, backups, recovery and activity coverage instead of developer-console terminology.
Kept technical detail available where it belongs in Diagnostics rather than normal answers.

sections.title: Design, Mobile & Accessibility
items: Moved the dashboard to a warmer charcoal-and-gold palette with lighter raised surfaces and clearer visual hierarchy.
Consolidated the active design palette into the canonical dashboard tokens instead of relying on a second late theme override.
Added stronger keyboard focus states, larger mobile targets, mobile bottom sheets and improved responsive layouts.
Added sticky table headers, configurable Ship columns, sorting, CSV export and rendering optimizations for larger datasets.
Improved empty states, contextual help and end-user wording across dashboard tools and Discord Wiki/Sentinel responses.
